_why: W6 game content tables (lore, glossary, hero / monster data). Proper names stay English (Phil's rule); every text field is shown through langDesc or a t() lookup at the display sites named.

tables.HERO_LORE: content: its text fields title, text are shown through langDesc at openGlossaryCard (glossary hero lore) and the hero screen Lore tab (heroDetail, heroTab==='lore'); registered in content_tables.d/w6.json
tables.GLOSSARY_INFO: names stay (name = monster / boss / summon names); its text field lore is shown through langDesc at openGlossaryCard; registered in content_tables.d/w6.json
tables.GLOSSARY_DATA: names: glossary entry ids and monster / boss names only (no text fields)
tables.KITS: names stay (green/blue/purple .name = skill names); its text field desc is shown through langDesc at skillDesc / passDescAt (hero detail, heroKitHtml glossary) and abilityTipHTML (battle tooltip); registered in content_tables.d/w6.json
tables.HERO_TYPES: names stay (name, abilityName = hero and ultimate names); its role words are shown through rosterClassName / herolist.role_* / edRoleTxt (roster card, hero detail, glossary, Skyfall skyTeamWhoHTML, Emberdraft); other strings are code ids (ability, source)
tables.MONSTER_TYPES: names stay (name = monster / boss / summon names); its role words are shown through rosterClassName (openGlossaryCard, glStatsHtml)
tables.MONSTER_KITS: names: monster skill names only (green/blue .name); the skill text shown is abilW (gloss.abil_* keys)
tables.HERO_SUBNAME: names: hero epithets (The Sky-Thrown ...) are part of the hero's name and stay English
